text.tspan: MASS PATCHING
@unhappychoice applies json 2.21.2 security fix to 8 repos simultaneously
OPENSSL CHAOS
@unhappychoice merges, reverts, and bans an openssl bump in the same week
UNSTOPPABLE
@unhappychoice fires off 195 commits across 7 straight days without blinking
HISTORIC MERGE
@unhappychoice ships gittype v0.10.2, fixing TUI resize bugs for terminal purists
REVIEW MACHINE
@unhappychoice approves 39 PRs this week. Zero rejections. Zero mercy for old deps.
PRICE CHECK
@unhappychoice syncs LLM pricing data in splashboard. Economists reportedly nervous.
OPEN SOURCE HERO
@unhappychoice spotted adding games to awesome-ttygames. Sources call it 'wholesome'
MAJOR VERSION
@unhappychoice yeets openai SDK from v6 to v7. No survivors in the old API surface.
